sections.title: Overview
content: The Smart Grid & Sustainable Energy Transition Lab is dedicated to advancing research, education, and innovation in modern energy systems.
Our work spans power systems, renewable integration, grid resilience, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

domains.title: Thematic Research Domains and Focus Areas

cards.title: Smart Grids, Digitalization, and Power System Intelligence
cards.text: Research on smart grid technologies, digital power systems, and cyber-physical infrastructures, including advanced sensing, communication, automation, and AI-driven monitoring and control.

cards.title: Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, and Electric Mobility
cards.text: Integration of renewable energy, energy storage systems, and electric vehicle infrastructure with power grids to enhance flexibility, reliability, and decarbonization.

cards.title: Energy Efficiency, Demand Side Management
cards.text: Development of energy efficiency measures, demand-side management, and demand response strategies to optimize energy use, reduce peak demand, and improve system performance.

cards.title: Power System Planning and Operation
cards.text: Analysis of long-term planning, real-time operation, and resilience of power systems under technical, economic, and climate-related uncertainties.

impact.title: Our Impact
items: Evidence-based research supporting national energy policies
Industry-driven solutions for power utilities and energy stakeholders
Skilled human resource development in modern power engineering
International research collaboration and knowledge exchange

sections.title: Mission & Vision
content: Our mission is to accelerate impactful discoveries that shape the future of sustainable and resilient energy infrastructure.
Our vision is to be a leader in energy systems innovation by fostering collaboration between academia, industry, and government.

sections.title: Industry Partners
content: We collaborate with utilities, manufacturers, engineering firms, and technology companies.
These partnerships enable real-world validation, technology transfer, and impactful applied research.
